description: This file defines the EnumDefinition class, which models an enumeration definition derived from an XML source. It contains information about enum values, their attributes, and methods to access this information. It also includes an inner class EnumValue representing individual enum entries.

classes.name: EnumDefinition
classes.description: Models an enumeration definition, including its name, description, and list of enum values.

classes.name: EnumDefinition.EnumValue
classes.description: Represents a single enumeration value, including its string value, numeric value, description, and short name.

methods.name: EnumDefinition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EnumDefinition object based on an ICEnumDefinition bean.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the enumeration.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the enumeration.

methods.name: doesNativeDefinitionExist
methods.description: Indicates whether a native definition for this enum exists elsewhere.

methods.name: generateNativeLabels
methods.description: Indicates whether native labels should be generated.

methods.name: generateNativeShortNames
methods.description: Indicates whether native short names should be generated.

methods.name: getEnumValues
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the enumeration values.

methods.name: getEnumCount
methods.description: Returns the count of enumeration values.
